meta.title: Parley — The open-source meeting recorder that keeps recordings on your computer
meta.description: Parley is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. Recordings and transcripts stay on your computer, you choose the transcription and AI providers, and analysis can run on Ollama on your own machine. Sign in to the cloud edition when you want your phone in sync. Live transcript split by speaker, a debrief after every meeting, search across everything, and a built-in MCP server.
meta.ogTitle: Your conversations go where you decide.
meta.ogDescription: An open-source meeting recorder: recordings stay on your computer, you pick the transcription and AI providers, and analysis can run locally. Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.
meta.ogImageAlt: Parley: Your conversations go where you decide. Recordings stay on your computer and connect straight to the transcription and AI services you chose, never through Parley's servers.
ld.features: Open source (Apache-2.0), Recordings and transcripts stored locally, Your choice of transcription and model providers, Local Ollama and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Live transcript split by speaker, Both sides of a call on the Mac, In-person recording on the phone, A debrief shaped by the kind of meeting, Search across every recording, Built-in MCP server (54 tools), Voice typing
hero.sub: Open-source meeting notes that stay on your computer, on the models you choose, even local ones.
hero.fine: Free. Bring your own keys, or use the cloud edition.
route.label: Where your data goes
route.capByok: Your conversations never pass through Parley's servers.
route.capCloud: The cloud edition sends recordings to Parley, for phone sync and zero setup.
demo.alt: Illustration: a renewal meeting being transcribed live.
demo.line1: We're happy with the platform overall. The blocker is the seat count — we budgeted for forty and the quote came back at eighty.
demo.line2: Forty is the floor on the enterprise tier, so I can't go under it. What I can do is hold this year's price through the next renewal.
shot.liveAlt: Parley on the desktop during a meeting: the live transcript on the left, coaching notes in the middle, the to-do list on the right
models.h2: Choose the model for each job.
models.p: Providers you already have contracts with, your own endpoint, or Ollama, so analysis never leaves the machine.
models.alt: The app's AI provider settings: Deepgram for transcription, Claude for realtime coaching, and Ollama on the same computer for deep analysis.
open.h2: Open source, so you can check.
open.p: The source is public under Apache-2.0. Build it yourself and run it on your own machines.
open.codeLabel: The commands that build Parley from source
meetings.h2: The transcript keeps up, speaker by speaker.
meetings.p: Both sides of any online call. In the room, just your phone.
after.h2: The report is ready when the meeting ends.
after.p: Takeaways, commitments, next steps, each linked to its moment.
after.alt: A Parley meeting report on the desktop: where it landed, commitments, what is still unknown and action items, each line with a timestamp
find.p: <kbd>⌘K</kbd> finds a line said a year ago.
find.alt: ⌘K over the desktop library: typing “renew” lists the Renewals folder and the Northwind renewal meeting
ai.h2: Your AI can read every meeting.
ai.p: An MCP server on your computer. One command connects Claude.
ai.codeLabel: The command that adds Parley to Claude Code
ai.chatAlt: Illustration: asked “What did we promise Northwind?”, an AI searches Parley and answers, each point with a timestamp that plays back that moment.
ai.chatA: Hold this year's price to the next renewal0:27, and send the new quote by Thursday1:32.
account.h2: Recorded on the phone, open on the computer.
account.p: The desktop app works without it.
account.altDesktop: All recordings on the desktop, by date, with folders for Renewals, New business and Internal in the sidebar
account.altPhone: The iPhone library: meetings by date, with upload markers and folders
voice.p: Dictate into any app with <kbd>⌥ Space</kbd>.
voice.raw: so <s>um</s> before Tuesday we need the quote and <s>uh</s> the security questionnaire
dl.windowsNote: Windows: if SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway.
